documentation:
/**
 * A function to see if a number is a palindrome.
 * Note that if the reversed number is larger than MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, rounding errors may occur and the result may be incorrect.
 * Time Complexity: O(log(n))
 *
 * @param number The input number.
 * @return {boolean} Wether the number is a Palindrome or not.
 */

contract.method: source-reviewed curated specification; not automatic extraction
contract.description: Return whether the base-10 digits of the integer read the same forwards and backwards. Zero is a palindrome; negative integers are not. Do not convert the number to text.
contract.domain: The argument is an integer between -1000000000 and 1000000000.

inputRoles.number: integer whose base-ten digits are tested

contract.outputRole: whether the integer has palindromic digits under the stated contract
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
